name: switch-hover
negative_note: issue #53 class: femtovg rasterizes edges via stencil+fringe with the AA band running -0.5px inside to +1.5px outside, so a border edge landing at a fractional device position covers a device-px sliver differently than coverage-integral drivers (software, skia, vello, Compose) — every switch track outline ring-diffs ~0.5-1px at d2 with a few strict pixels left in the edge slivers while track fill, thumb and geometry match; a silent pass on femtovg would mean the harness went blind
